Overview

Hackathon Format — Two Rounds

INNOVATE will be conducted entirely online, with free participation.

Round 1 — Idea and Solution Submission

Submit a presentation of up to five slides and a demonstration video of up to three minutes covering:

  • The everyday problem and intended users.
  • Your proposed solution using AI, machine learning, statistics, or data analytics.
  • A working prototype, dashboard, or functional no-code solution.
  • Tools, data sources, and expected impact.

Teams will be shortlisted based on problem relevance, originality, functionality, and practical usefulness.

Round 2 — Live Online Finale

Shortlisted teams will present their solutions to the jury:

  • Presentation and demonstration: Five minutes.
  • Jury questions: Three minutes.

Winners will receive full access to AVEERANEX LEARN, including courses, hands-on labs, interactive visualizations, a coding playground, and 200+ industry case studies with certifications upon successful assessment and Internship at AVEERANEX
